★ Services ★

Car rental services in Islamabad, Rawalpindi & beyond

Whatever the occasion, one call to SLC gets you the right vehicle, an experienced driver and a clear quote.

Rent a car with driver

Courteous, experienced chauffeurs who know every route in the twin cities and across Pakistan. Sit back and let us drive.

Self drive car rental

Prefer to drive yourself? Rent selected cars on a self drive basis with simple documentation and a refundable deposit.

Corporate & NGO contracts

Monthly and project-based fleets for organisations, with dedicated drivers and consolidated corporate invoicing.

Airport pick & drop

Wedding & event cars

Mercedes S-Class, Audi, Lexus and Land Cruiser V8 for the barat, sedans for family, plus Grand Cabin and Coaster for guests. Arriving on time.

Tours & northern areas

4x4 Prado, Fortuner and Land Cruiser V8 for Murree, Naran, Skardu and Hunza, driven by drivers experienced on mountain roads.

★ FAQ ★

Car rental questions, answered

Do you offer cars with a driver?

Yes. Every vehicle can be booked with a trained, uniformed professional driver who knows Islamabad, Rawalpindi and intercity routes. Self-drive is also available for selected cars, subject to documents and security deposit.

How much does it cost to rent a car per day in Islamabad?

Our daily rates start at PKR 4,000 for a Suzuki Alto and PKR 6,000 for a Toyota Corolla or Honda City. SUVs such as the Prado are PKR 15,000, the Land Cruiser V8 PKR 25,000, and luxury cars start at PKR 35,000. Every car's rate is on our fleet page.

What documents do I need to rent a car?

For rentals with a driver, a CNIC (or passport for foreign nationals) and a contact number are enough. For self-drive, we need your CNIC, a valid driving licence and a refundable security deposit.

Do you provide airport pick and drop?

Yes. We provide 24/7 pick and drop at Islamabad International Airport, with flight tracking so your driver is waiting even if your flight is delayed.

Can I rent a car for out-of-city trips and the northern areas?

Absolutely. We regularly arrange trips to Lahore, Peshawar, Murree, Naran, Skardu, Hunza and across Pakistan. 4x4s such as the Prado, Fortuner and Land Cruiser V8 are ideal for mountain roads.

Do you offer monthly and corporate rental contracts?

Yes. For 13 years we have served NGOs, banks, development projects and companies with monthly and long-term contracts, dedicated drivers and consolidated corporate invoicing.

How do I book a car?

Call us, send a WhatsApp message or fill in the booking form on this page with your dates and preferred car. We confirm availability and the rate, usually within minutes.

Do you deliver the car to my sector or home?

Yes. We deliver to your home, office or hotel in every Islamabad sector, Blue Area, Bahria Town, DHA and the rest of Rawalpindi, and to Islamabad International Airport. Tell us the address and time when you book.

Is fuel included in the rental?

It depends on the package. City packages and outstation trips are quoted either with or without fuel. We always confirm what is included before you book, with no hidden charges.

Where is SLC Car Rental Services located, and what are your hours?

Our office is in Kashif Bell-Air Plaza, G-8 Markaz, Islamabad. Bookings are open Mon–Sun, 24 hours, by phone, WhatsApp or the booking form on this site.
